mapper.select: SELECT lb.live_broadcast_id, lb.member_id, lb.title, lb.description, lb.status, lb.stream_url, lb.started_at, lb.ended_at, lb.view_count, lb.created_at, lb.updated_at FROM live_broadcast lb ORDER BY lb.created_at DESC

SELECT lb.live_broadcast_id, lb.member_id, lb.title, lb.description, lb.status, lb.stream_url, lb.started_at, lb.ended_at, lb.view_count, lb.created_at, lb.updated_at FROM live_broadcast lb WHERE lb.live_broadcast_id = #{liveBroadcastId} ORDER BY lb.created_at DESC

SELECT lb.live_broadcast_id, lb.member_id, lb.title, lb.description, lb.status, lb.stream_url, lb.started_at, lb.ended_at, lb.view_count, lb.created_at, lb.updated_at FROM live_broadcast lb WHERE lb.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY lb.created_at DESC
